outcome: Admission of the newborn into the neonatal unit within 24 h following delivery
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies who spontaneously laboured at term (beyond 37 weeks of gestation)
finding: Increasing maternal age was independently associated with increased risk of operative delivery and perineal trauma.
mod_finding: Increasing maternal age was found to be an independent risk factor for operative delivery (including assisted vaginal delivery and cesarean section) and perineal trauma.
